```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)

library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(leaflet)
library(leaflet.extras)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(plotly)
library(here)
library(httr)
library(tidyr)


# load data that has the dates the historic districts were designated
# comes from here: https://planning.dc.gov/page/dc-historic-districts
hd_data <- readr::read_csv("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Ajl1iAS0NRB7vk_UFDveeWzGkwf3tuiDo-zV9_wtzRM/gviz/tq?tqx=out:csv&sheet=data", show_col_types = F)

hd_shp <- st_read("https://maps2.dcgis.dc.gov/dcgis/rest/services/DCGIS_DATA/Historic_WebMercator/MapServer/6/query?outFields=*&where=1%3D1&f=geojson")

# Merge historic district (HD) data onto HD shapefile, subset to only look at neighborhood HDs:
historic_districts <- dplyr::left_join(x = hd_shp, y = hd_data, by = "UNIQUEID")
historic_districts <- historic_districts %>% filter(Neighborhood_HD==1)


buildings   <- st_read("data/DC_buildings_height_2024_MEAN.json")
buildings_2 <- 
  read_csv("data/dc_buildings.csv", show_col_types = F) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("centroid_lon", "centroid_lat"), crs = 4326)

```


```{r}
# Project to UTM Zone 18N (meters) so distances are meaningful
crs_m <- 32618
district_name_col = "LABEL"
height_col        = "bldg_ht_m"
dist_buffer       = 100


buildings          <- st_transform(buildings, crs_m)
buildings_2        <- st_transform(buildings_2, crs_m)
historic_districts <- st_transform(historic_districts, crs_m)

# Add a unique building ID for tracking
buildings   <- buildings %>% mutate(bldg_id = row_number())
buildings_2 <- buildings_2 %>% mutate(bldg_id = row_number())

# ── Use building centroids for cleaner point-in-polygon logic ───────────────
# (avoids edge cases where large buildings straddle a boundary)
building_centroids <- buildings %>%
  mutate(geometry = st_centroid(geometry))


get_summary_df <- function(historic_districts, building_centroids, height_col, dist_buffer, district_name_col) {
  # ── Create X meter band on both sides of each district boundary ───────────────
  boundary_bands <- historic_districts %>%
    select(district = all_of(district_name_col)) %>%
    mutate(geometry = st_buffer(st_boundary(geometry), dist = dist_buffer))
  
  # ── Find all buildings within the 100m band (either side) ──────────────────
  near_boundary <- st_join(
    building_centroids %>% select(bldg_id, all_of(height_col)),
    boundary_bands,
    join = st_intersects
  ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(district)) %>%
    st_drop_geometry()
  
  # ── Identify buildings inside each specific district ───────────────────────
  inside <- st_join(
    building_centroids %>% select(bldg_id),
    historic_districts %>% select(district = all_of(district_name_col)),
    join = st_within
  ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(district)) %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    mutate(inside_district = TRUE)
  
  # ── Flag buildings inside ANY historic district ───────────────────────
  inside_any <- inside %>%
    distinct(bldg_id) %>%
    mutate(inside_any_district = TRUE)
  
  # ── Join, label, and filter ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  results <- near_boundary %>%
    left_join(inside,     by = c("bldg_id", "district")) %>%
    left_join(inside_any, by = "bldg_id") %>%
    mutate(
      inside_district     = coalesce(inside_district,     FALSE),
      inside_any_district = coalesce(inside_any_district, FALSE),
      location = if_else(
        inside_district,
        "Inside (≤100m from boundary)",
        "Outside (≤100m from boundary)"
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(
      inside_district |        # always keep inside buildings
      !inside_any_district     # only keep outside buildings if not in ANY district
    )
  
  # ── Summarise by district ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  summary_table <- results %>%
    group_by(district, location) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_height_m = mean(.data[[height_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
      n_buildings   = n(),
      .groups       = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(district, location)
  
  # print(summary_table)
  
  # ── Wide format for side-by-side comparison ────────────────────────────────
  # summary_wide <- summary_table %>%
  #   tidyr::pivot_wider(
  #     names_from  = location,
  #     values_from = c(mean_height_m, n_buildings)
  #   ) %>%
  #   janitor::clean_names() %>%
  #   mutate(height_difference_m = mean_height_m_inside_100m_from_boundary -
  #                                 mean_height_m_outside_100m_from_boundary) %>%
  #   arrange(desc(abs(height_difference_m)))
  
  # print(summary_wide)
  return(summary_table)
}
```

## Using DC lidar data:

```{r}
summary_table <-
  get_summary_df(
  historic_districts = historic_districts,
  building_centroids = building_centroids, 
  height_col = "bldg_ht_m", 
  dist_buffer = 100, 
  district_name_col = "LABEL"
  )

```

```{r, fig.height=12, fig.width=8, out.width="100%"}
ggplot(summary_table, aes(x = reorder(district, mean_height_m), 
                           y = mean_height_m, 
                           fill = location)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0("n=", n_buildings)),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
            hjust     = -0.1,
            size      = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Inside (≤100m from boundary)"  = "#619CFF",
    "Outside (≤100m from boundary)" = "#F8766D"
  )) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title    = "Mean Building Height Near Historic District Boundaries",
    subtitle = "Comparing buildings within 100m inside vs. outside each district",
    x        = NULL,
    y        = "Mean Height (m)",
    fill     = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r, fig.height=10, fig.width=10, out.width="100%"}

scatter_data <- summary_table %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = location,
    values_from = c(mean_height_m, n_buildings)
  ) %>%
  janitor::clean_names() %>%
  # average n_buildings across inside/outside for point sizing
  mutate(n_buildings_avg = (n_buildings_inside_100m_from_boundary + 
                             n_buildings_outside_100m_from_boundary) / 2) %>%
  mutate(district = stringr::str_remove(string = district, pattern = " HD"))

ggplot(scatter_data, 
       aes(x = mean_height_m_outside_100m_from_boundary,
           y = mean_height_m_inside_100m_from_boundary,
           size = n_buildings_avg,
           label = district)) +
  # 45-degree reference line (where inside == outside)
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey40") +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, color = "#619CFF") +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(size = 3, max.overlaps = 20) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 12), name = "Avg. # Buildings") +
  labs(
    title    = "Mean Building Height Inside vs. Outside Historic District Boundaries",
    subtitle = "Points above the dotted line = taller inside than outside; size = number of buildings",
    x        = "Mean Height Outside (m)",
    y        = "Mean Height Inside (m)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

```


```{r, fig.height=7, fig.width=9, out.width="100%"}
scatter_data %>%
  mutate(
    height_difference_ft = (mean_height_m_outside_100m_from_boundary -
                          mean_height_m_inside_100m_from_boundary) *
                          3.28084
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(district, height_difference_ft),
             y = height_difference_ft,
             fill = height_difference_ft > 0)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey40") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("TRUE" = "#619CFF", "FALSE" = "#F8766D"),
    labels = c("TRUE" = "Taller outside", "FALSE" = "Taller inside"),
    name   = NULL
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = "Difference in Mean Building Height: Inside vs. Outside Historic Districts",
    subtitle = "Positive values = taller outside the district; negative = taller inside",
    x        = NULL,
    y        = "Height Difference (ft)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position    = "bottom",
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
  )

```


```{r, out.width="100%"}

summary_table %>%
  group_by(location) %>%
  summarise(mean_height_ft = mean(mean_height_m, na.rm = TRUE) * 3.28084) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = location, y = mean_height_ft, fill = location)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(mean_height_ft)),
            vjust = -0.5,
            size  = 5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Inside (≤100m from boundary)"  = "#F8766D",
    "Outside (≤100m from boundary)" = "#619CFF"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "Mean Building Height Inside vs. Outside Historic Districts",
    x     = NULL,
    y     = "Mean Height (ft)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position   = "none",
    panel.grid.major  = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank()
  ) +
  ylim(c(0, 42))
```
